import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
acct['d'] = acct.date.dt.date
pre = acct[acct.d < pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22').date()]
post = acct[acct.d >= pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22').date()]
ndays_pre = pre.d.nunique(); ndays_post = post.d.nunique()
g = acct.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(
    pre_avg=('unblended_cost', lambda s: 0.0), )
# do separately
p1 = pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].sum()/ndays_pre
p2 = post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].sum()/ndays_post
cmp = pd.concat([p1.rename('pre'), p2.rename('post')], axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['delta'] = cmp.post - cmp.pre
print(cmp.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(15))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
acct['d']=acct.date.dt.date
anom = acct[acct.d==pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22').date()]
print(anom.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application'])['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head())
pre = acct[acct.d < anom.d.iloc[0]]
print("services only in anomaly day:", set(zip(anom.csp,anom.cloud_service,anom.application)) - set(zip(pre.csp,pre.cloud_service,pre.application)))
# check other services' deltas on that specific day vs their pre-average
p1 = pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].mean()
a1 = anom.set_index(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost']
cmp = pd.concat([p1.rename('pre_avg'), a1.rename('day')],axis=1).dropna()
cmp['delta']=cmp.day-cmp.pre_avg
print(cmp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(15))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
anom = acct[acct.date==pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22')]
new = anom[anom.instance_family.isin(['LzGJ9rhJoA','q10uAtDIqF','JvKGRn9oaQ','nbJ0X8TQ4n','9JSKdPztdB','C4JJjdjpR2','EeqjKx3K5D','QHfxsO7Tbi','PvjSNbcfQ1'])]

print("total new:", new.unblended_cost.sum())
# check no other resource changed level persistently: compare per-day-of-window averages pre vs post excluding these
pre = acct[acct.date < '2025-09-22']; post = acct[(acct.date>='2025-09-22') & ~acct.instance_family.isin(new.instance_family)]
p1 = pre.groupby('instance_family')['unblended_cost'].sum()/pre.date.nunique()
p2 = post.groupby('instance_family')['unblended_cost'].sum()/post.date.nunique()
c = pd.concat([p1,p2],axis=1,join='outer').fillna(0); c.columns=['pre','post']; c['d']=c.post-c.pre
print(c.sort_values('d',ascending=False).head(5))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])

pre = acct[acct.d < pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22').date()]
post = acct[acct.d >= pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22').date()]
ndays_pre = pre.d.nunique(); ndays_post = post.d.nunique()
g = acct.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(
    pre_avg=('unblended_cost', lambda s: 0.0), )
# do separately

p2 = post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].sum()/ndays_post
cmp = pd.concat([p1.rename('pre'), p2.rename('post')], axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['delta'] = cmp.post - cmp.pre
print(cmp.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(15))"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
anom = acct[acct.date==pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22')]
new = anom[anom.instance_family.isin(['LzGJ9rhJoA','q10uAtDIqF','JvKGRn9oaQ','nbJ0X8TQ4n','9JSKdPztdB','C4JJjdjpR2','EeqjKx3K5D','QHfxsO7Tbi','PvjSNbcfQ1'])]
print(new[['instance_family','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']])
print("total new:", new.unblended_cost.sum())
# check no other resource changed level persistently: compare per-day-of-window averages pre vs post excluding these
pre = acct[acct.date < '2025-09-22']; post = acct[(acct.date>='2025-09-22') & ~acct.instance_family.isin(new.instance_family)]
p1 = pre.groupby('instance_family')['unblended_cost'].sum()/pre.date.nunique()
p2 = post.groupby('instance_family')['unblended_cost'].sum()/post.date.nunique()
c = pd.concat([p1,p2],axis=1,join='outer').fillna(0); c.columns=['pre','post']; c['d']=c.post-c.pre
print(c.sort_values('d',ascending=False).head(5))"}
